# Icon manifest selection disposition

Parent decision, 2026-10-23. Accept D01-D10 of the [proposal](../manifest-contract/decisions.md) as the concrete selection contract for the next icon slice after feedback/panel acceptance. The finite set is **36 concepts, 48 Material names, 54 Android artwork variants, 58 contextual bindings and 50 SF literals**. The original proposal remains unchanged, with its recommendation/provenance distinctions intact. This decision supplies the parent selection; it does not start a second implementation owner during feedback/panel work.

Unspecified ordinary-action fills default to 0. The additional dual-fill `group`, `present_to_all` and `keep` entries each have a specific open/status consumer. Lock and sharing use their specified active/off glyphs and the canonical toggle rule. Warning/error use the proposed solid silhouette next to explanatory text; info stays outlined. Back and Send mirror in RTL, matching the core Back contract and S40 composer. All other selected artwork explicitly does not mirror. No automatic fill cross-product, unknown-name fallback, legacy alias or raw glyph ID as accessibility copy is authorized.

The parent read the complete proposal/brief, reran its standard-library offline validation successfully, checked the Send mirroring source, and looked up every selected SF literal in the installed Apple name-availability catalog. All 50 names map to iOS 17.0 or earlier. The four previously unverified additions are `pin.fill`, `mic.slash` and `video.slash` (iOS 13.0), and `rectangle.inset.filled.on.rectangle` (iOS 15.0). [Exact catalog/hash/records](sf-availability.json). This closes their metadata-evidence gap only. The historical proposal correctly says its own lane did not perform those lookups; do not rewrite that evidence into a runtime claim.

Use the [implementation brief](../manifest-contract/implementation-brief.md) for strict SVG interpretation, offline generation, lazy native accessors, caller-owned accessibility, inert Debug gallery and retained license requirements. The implementation may use a compact source schema and deduplicate shared provenance records while preserving exact identities, explicit finite choices and validation. Do not copy temporary absolute evidence paths into a permanent build or generated artifact. Vendored repository inputs and relative references must make generation self-contained and offline.

The original 96 acquired pairs remain a superset; 42 are not selected for native output in this slice. Feature-only routes/game/layout artwork stays explicitly deferred. All converted vectors still need independent semantic geometry checks and renderer comparison, including holes, smooth quadratics, viewport translation and RTL behavior. Drift-check agreement is not geometry proof. Actual iOS symbol lookup/rendering, minimum-OS runtime, native compilation, lazy construction/identity and accessible gallery verification remain required. No source, generator, geometry, runtime, feedback/panel, full WP1 or release acceptance is implied.

Adaptive inspector and retained-stage work follows through the accepted panel coordinator in its separate slice. This selection adds no navigation or media owner. The next implementation must re-read the final feedback/panel API before gallery integration.
